title: Casino expanding hover banners

questions.title: Should VIP Progress and Daily Race join the expanding row?
questions.text: Should VIP Progress and Daily Race join the expanding row?
questions.context: Our banner row mixes two player widgets (VIP Progress, $25k Daily Race) with promo banners in one carousel (casino-lobby-banners.tsx:445–459). The BRD says "banners", and the peer row in your screenshot is promos only.
questions.why: It decides whether the widgets need their own expanded detail and how much width is left for the promos at 1440.

options.label: Widgets join the accordion (recommended)
options.detail: Every card expands on hover; VIP shows next reward and Race shows the top 3, so all of the row gets "more info".

options.label: Widgets stay fixed on the left
options.detail: VIP and Race keep today's 288px cards and only the promos to their right expand.

options.label: Promos only, widgets move out
options.detail: The row becomes promos only and VIP/Race move to a separate strip below it.

questions.title: Keep the 164px banner height, or make the row taller like the peer?
questions.text: Keep the 164px banner height, or make the row taller like the peer?
questions.context: Today's banners are 164px (Figma 69-47911, casino-lobby-banners.tsx:284), so the expanded body copy gets clipped. The peer row is roughly 2.4× taller. A taller row pushes Continue Playing down, and the target is to cut time to first casino bet from about 8 minutes to under 2 (BRIEF.md).
questions.why: It sets how much the expanded card can show and whether game shelves stay above the fold at 1440×900.

options.label: Grow to ~240px (recommended)
options.detail: Room for full body copy and CTA while Continue Playing still starts above the fold.

options.label: Keep 164px
options.detail: The row only widens on hover, the body stays at 3 lines, and shelves don't move.

options.label: Hero height ~380px like the peer
options.detail: Big art moment, but Continue Playing drops below the fold at 1440×900.

proposalSummary: In the casino lobby banner row, one card is open at a time and the rest collapse to narrow strips. Hover or Tab opens a card, so all 6 cards fit at 1440 and nothing hides behind a chevron (today 2 of 4 promos are off-screen and the copy gets clipped). Following your answers, VIP Progress and Daily Race now expand too (next-level note, top 3 of the race), the row is 240px tall, and on mobile it stays a swipe rail with full info on every card.

journey.detail: The row loads with the first promo open and every other card visible as a strip.
It widens in 300ms with the house ease while the last open card closes. Content fades in after it settles; reduced motion makes it instant.
Promos show full body copy and the CTA. VIP shows level, % and what unlocks next. Race shows Position, Wagered, Prize and the top 3.
Same actions as today (launch game, category soft-nav, cashier, VIP Hub) with the existing 2.2s launch spinner.
Swipe-only rail of 300×200 cards in their open layout. No tap-to-open, no chevrons.

prototypes.summary: On desktop the casino lobby banner row is now a 240px accordion: hover or Tab opens a card while the rest stay visible as strips. On mobile it stays a swipe rail with full info on every card.
changes: Replaced the placeholder VIP copy with real Silver data: Weekly Boost + $25 Level Up Bonus (vip-hub.ts).
If banner art fails to load, the card falls back to the plain card surface and the copy switches to surface colours.
Clicking the CTA now shows the same 2.2s launch spinner as clicking the card.
Added a visible keyboard focus ring and press scale on the CTA.
Mobile cards are 288×208 with a stronger scrim so the copy reads over the art.
All sizes moved to Lumen scale tokens: token lint passes with 0 violations, and the type-check shows no new errors.
